epics.title: M0 Solid Ground — foundation & modernization
epics.description: Modernize the platform and make truth continuously visible. Exit gate: green pipeline on .NET 8, CVE-clean, docs truthful.

features.title: CI/CD pipeline live with merged coverage
features.description: Commit azure-pipelines.yml (repo root); branch policy on develop requires green build+tests; publish merged unit+integration coverage. AC: PR cannot merge red; coverage visible per build.

features.title: GitVersion semantic versioning (Case.Flow-* tags)
features.description: GitVersion.yml at repo root (GitFlow increments, tag-prefix Case.Flow-, baseline 1.0.0 via next-version) + Version job in Case.Flow.CI republishing outputs and naming runs <X.Y.Z>-<label>.<counter>. AC: develop builds emit 1.0.0-develop.<n> as previews of 1.0.0; Case.Flow-1.0.0 tag pushed at GA flips main to clean 1.0.0 and develop to 1.1.0-develop.<n>; assemblies stamped with AssemblySemVer/InformationalVersion.

features.title: .NET 10 LTS + latest Orleans migration
features.description: net10.0 across all projects (current LTS; .NET 8 EOL Nov 2026). Latest stable Orleans: [GenerateSerializer] sweep + JSON fallback for XSD-generated model, Host/TestCluster builders, memory streams, Jint 4.x with sandbox budgets, license-safe dependency refresh (AutoMapper pinned 12.0.1 MIT, FluentAssertions 7.x), remove OrleansAzureUtils. AC: 209 tests green natively, no roll-forward, vulnerable scan clean.

features.title: Dependency & CVE remediation
features.description: Newtonsoft.Json >=13.0.1, AutoMapper patch, transitive criticals (System.Text.Encodings.Web, System.Drawing.Common). AC: dotnet list package --vulnerable clean, gated in CI.

features.title: Systemic bug fixes with pinning tests
features.description: Fix Task.Factory.StartNew(async) Task<Task> at 4 sites; BaseEvent.Occurred replay timestamps; HashSet<OnPart> identity equality; sentry double-satisfy guard. AC: regression test per fix (see docs/06 section 3.2).

features.title: Documentation corrections
features.description: Apply docs/06 section 5 correction list: README claims match runtime reality (no 'full CMMN 1.1' overclaim), doc 02 metric fixes, doc 03 Phase-3 contradiction, add the three omitted material facts.

features.title: Replace Newtonsoft.Json with System.Text.Json
features.description: Remove Newtonsoft solution-wide: Orleans fallback serializer moves to System.Text.Json with polymorphism preserved for the XSD-generated CMMN hierarchy (resolver-modifier reading XmlInclude, or JsonDerivedType via partials) with a pinning round-trip test; rewrite the Jint case-file bridge (JObjectInstance/JTokenExtensions) against JsonNode; strip Newtonsoft attributes from the frozen generated model. AC: no Newtonsoft PackageReference anywhere, all tests green, polymorphic round-trip test proves no subtype collapse. Partial delivery acceptable only if the Jint bridge proves blocking - report the boundary.

epics.title: M1 True Engine — spec data plane
epics.description: Close the gap between state-machine demo and licensable engine. Exit gate: data-driven demo case (risk score triggers discretionary procedures) runs end-to-end; conformance scenario suite green.

features.title: CaseFile / CaseFileItem grains (spec 8.3)
features.description: Full CaseFileItem lifecycle + operations publishing CaseFileItemTransitionedEvent; unblocks case-file sentries and timer start triggers (deviation D2).

features.title: Expression context binder (fixes D1)
features.description: Typed dot-path case-file access injected into every evaluation; shared across expression engines. Today all expressions run in an empty JS context (ExpressionGrain.cs:68-95).

features.title: Sentry completion: D3, D5, D6, D10
features.description: ifPart-only sentry evaluation; per-repetition sentry reset; stage exit-criteria subscription on create path; PlanItemOnPart.sentryRef mode; fault event on ifPart error.

features.title: Rules completion: D4, D7, D8
features.description: Stage autoComplete=false per Table 8.12 OR-structure; repetition first-eval discard + repeat-on-complete for no-entry-criteria items; CasePlanModelBehavior close/lockdown semantics.

features.title: Structural .cmmn import/export + capability lint
features.description: XmlSerializer path over the XSD-generated model (docs/06 section 2.4); golden-file round-trips vs Trisotech/Flowable samples; lint warns/rejects constructs the runtime cannot honor.

features.title: Conformance scenario suite (internal TCK)
features.description: Generate state-transition tests from spec Tables 8.5-8.11. No official OMG TCK exists — this suite becomes a marketable asset and the coverage backbone.

features.title: DECISION GATE: licensing model
features.description: Source-available + commercial embedded (Camunda-8-style) vs OSS-core + enterprise (Flowable-style) vs closed commercial. Must decide before M2 API surface freezes.

features.title: Remove AutoMapper (license + CVE exposure)
features.description: AutoMapper pinned at 14.0.0 (last MIT) carries GHSA-rvv3-g6hj-g44x (High, DoS); fix versions are post-license-change. The profile is ~6 fixed-shape Store->Snapshot maps - replace with hand-written mapping code, drop the package. AC: package removed, vulnerable scan fully clean, mapping covered by existing snapshot tests.

epics.title: M-EXPR Expression languages (FEEL first)
epics.description: Pluggable expression architecture; FEEL as flagship authored language; XPath compat gated; JUEL as import-shim only. See docs/07 section 5.

features.title: Pluggable IExpressionEngine + sandbox budgets
features.description: Registry keyed by Expression.Language URI; per-engine timeout/statement/memory budgets (fixes B4 for Jint); compilation cache.

features.title: FEEL spike: feelin-on-Jint vs native .NET port
features.description: Evaluate bpmn-io's feelin (JS FEEL engine) hosted on the existing Jint sandbox vs porting/adopting a .NET FEEL implementation. Output: decision memo + benchmark.

features.title: FEEL GA as flagship authored language
features.description: Full ifPart/rule/timer expression support in FEEL; docs; modeler autocomplete lands with M3. DMN synergy for future DecisionTask.

features.title: XPath compatibility mode (gated)
features.description: Spec-default language for imported conformant models; System.Xml.XPath over case-file XML projection. Gate on conformance marketing value (M1 decision).

features.title: JUEL import-translation shim (best-effort)
features.description: Translate common ${...} subset at import with per-expression warnings; explicitly NOT a runtime engine (JUEL is Java EL; no credible .NET runtime).

epics.title: M2 Cloud Native — production runtime, API, tenancy
epics.description: Runs somewhere real. Exit gate: chaos test (silo kill mid-case loses no timers/events); authenticated API demo; benchmark report.

features.title: Deployed Orleans: clustering, durable state & streams
features.description: Azure clustering + durable grain/journal storage; replace fire-and-forget SMS streams for criticality-1 events; snapshotting; event-schema versioning. Fixes B1.

features.title: Durable timers + scheduler keying fix
features.description: Orleans Reminders (or clustered AdoJobStore Quartz); fix Guid.Empty singleton scheduler (B2/B3). AC: silo crash loses zero timers.

features.title: REST API + OpenAPI + Flow.Client SDK
features.description: Definitions CRUD/versioning, case lifecycle, task inbox, planning ops, case-file ops, history queries; NuGet client SDK. Optional gRPC.

features.title: AuthN/Z + tenant enforcement
features.description: OIDC; per-call tenant enforcement filter replacing ambient-context trust (B5); runtime role-to-user resolution. Multi-tenant isolation tests (zero exist today).

features.title: SerializationBinder allowlist for JSON fallback
features.description: The Orleans Newtonsoft fallback uses TypeNameHandling.Auto (required for the polymorphic CMMN model). Add a custom ISerializationBinder allowlisting the CMMN model types + JToken family as defense-in-depth; mandatory before any external API surface (M2 REST) ships. AC: binder in place on silo + client + test fixture; negative test proving unlisted $type is rejected.

features.title: Docker support: silo image + eval compose stack
features.description: Containerize the silo (decide SDK-native PublishContainer vs multi-stage Dockerfile; non-root, health checks, net10.0 base). docker-compose evaluation stack (silo + Seq now; Azurite/SQL as M2 storage lands) doubling as the licensee trial experience. Images tagged from GitVersion (case.flow/silo:<version>), built/pushed by Case.Flow.CD on develop/main. AC: docker compose up yields a working local cluster + endpoint; image builds in CI. Start after the .NET 10 migration merges (base images).

features.title: Observability + reference deployment
features.description: OpenTelemetry traces/metrics, health checks, Helm chart / Bicep for AKS or Container Apps (consumes the Docker images from the docker-support feature).

features.title: Benchmark report: 10k cases x 50 plan items
features.description: Publishable scale numbers incl. activation-storm mitigation results. Sales asset.

epics.title: M3 Faces — modeler, tasklist, inspector
epics.description: Model, deploy, run, inspect — visually. Exit gate: recordable end-to-end demo. UI stack decision is the first story.

features.title: SPIKE FIRST: modeler stack diligence (cmmn-js)
features.description: cmmn-js is effectively unmaintained and carries the bpmn.io watermark license. Decide: fork-and-own vs rebuild on diagram-js vs commercial license. Output: decision memo + legal check. Biggest UI risk; 1-2 wks.

features.title: Web modeler MVP
features.description: Author/validate CMMN diagrams; deploy to engine via API (round-trips section-9 import/export); FEEL-first expression autocomplete.

features.title: Tasklist app
features.description: Human-task inbox: claim/complete; planning-table discretionary-item selection UX; simple forms (evaluate form-js).

features.title: Case inspector (cockpit)
features.description: Live plan-item state overlaid on the diagram; event-sourced timeline replay (differentiator: full audit trail); sentry/criteria status view.

features.title: Admin console
features.description: Tenants, definition versions, in-flight migration policies.

epics.title: M4 Commercialization — package, prove, sell
epics.description: Someone can buy this. Licensing implemented, docs/samples shipped, design partners engaged, sale-readiness data room assembled.

features.title: Licensing implementation
features.description: Per M1 gate: repo/licensing split, notices, bpmn.io compliance, license keys if applicable.

features.title: Docs site + quickstarts + samples gallery
features.description: Model-to-running-case in 15 minutes; samples: insurance claim, employee onboarding, audit engagement showcase (risk-tailored program via planning tables + Crunchafi data-extraction feed).

features.title: Conformance + benchmark whitepapers
features.description: Publish internal TCK results and M2 benchmark. Credibility assets for licensing conversations.

features.title: Design-partner program
features.description: 2-3 partners: .NET ISVs needing case semantics; one audit/accounting firm via Crunchafi network. Feedback loop into backlog.

features.title: Pricing, packaging, sale-readiness data room
features.description: Embedded per-app license / per-core self-host / managed SaaS tiers; IP audit (XmlSchemaClassGenerator MIT, OMG spec usage, bpmn.io posture, no PPC content); architecture dossier (docs 01-07).
